problem:
A concert venue is tracking the rate at which guests enter the building. The rate $r(t)$ at which guests arrive is given by the function

$$
r(t)=3\sqrt{t+1},
$$

where $r(t)$ is measured in guests per minute, and $t>0$ is the time in minutes.

Between $t=0$ and $t=3$ minutes, to one decimal place,
{{field-1}} guests arrived.
